regime_context: Only two themes pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate (Banks, Innovative Pharma & CXO) and one of them is the dominant, crowded one-narrative leader that is not a crowded fade. The gate's historical edge did not hold on this market (gate_helps=false) and the breadth of rotation is narrow with no confirmed handoff. Given a track record with only 0.366 directional accuracy on 123 calls, defaults are for low conviction and few theses.
emerging_watch: Watch Robotics & Automation: it leads the raw momentum rank but is not trend-gate eligible. It stays a retirement watch unless its durability bar rises above roughly 0.55-0.60 and its breadth widens substantively from 0.545, which would move it toward a CONFIRMED leadership handoff from Banks.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Despite the fact that the absolute-trend gate has not historically reduced drawdown in this market, Banks is the only eligible theme that is also the dominant one-narrative leader, with the strongest durability, breadth, and a trend Hurst tag. The lean is not because it is ranked first, but as a tide-following continuation conditional on its durability bar not breaking.
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded (z=1.72) which historically means upside from here is capped even if leadership continues; and with no basket-level drawdown edge in this market, any A-share drawdown will whipsaw this theme exactly like the overall tape.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: It is the only other topic that passes the absolute-trend eligibility gate, but it is crowded, has a mixed Hurst tag, and sits at the bottom of the eligibility list. It is not a sell or short, just a relative underweight against the dominant Banks narrative, reflecting its low rank, high crowding, and weak score.
theses.dissent: Healthcare is defensive and broadly cohesive (0.571 breadth) with a high durability bar near 0.60, so if risk appetite rolls over and value/financials fade, it could hold up better than its score suggests.
